faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Here are answers to commonly asked questions. If you can't find what you're looking for, please feel free to contact our support team.
faq.footer: If you have any other questions, please don't hesitate to contact support.

1.question: What are the main features of this calendar app?
1.answer: This calendar app allows you to create, edit, and delete events, manage multiple calendars, invite members, configure notifications, use dark mode, display rokuyou (traditional Japanese calendar markers), and show holidays.

2.question: Can I create multiple calendars?
2.answer: Yes, you can. You can create new calendars from the 'Create Calendar' option in the sidebar and manage multiple calendars for different purposes such as family, work, and personal use.

3.question: How do I invite other users to my calendar?
3.answer: After selecting a calendar, choose 'Invite Members' from the options menu. You can invite other users using either a QR code or an invite link.

4.question: How does QR code invitation work?
4.answer: Select 'Invite with QR Code' on the member invitation screen to display a QR code. The person you want to invite can join the calendar by scanning this QR code.

5.question: What should I do if I'm not receiving notifications?
5.answer: First, check if 'Push Notifications' is enabled in the settings screen. Also, make sure that notification permissions for the app are enabled in your device settings.

6.question: How do I set up today's schedule notifications?
6.answer: You can customize the notification time and display content from 'Today's Schedule' in the settings. You'll receive daily notifications about your schedule at the specified time.

7.question: How do I switch to dark mode?
7.answer: Turn on the 'Dark Mode' switch in the 'Display Settings' section of the settings screen to change the entire app to a dark theme.

8.question: Can I display rokuyou (Japanese calendar markers like taian, butsumetsu)?
8.answer: Yes, you can. Turn on the 'Rokuyou' switch in the settings screen to display rokuyou on the calendar.

9.question: How do I change holiday display settings?
9.answer: You can change holiday display settings from 'Holidays' in the settings screen. We use the Google Calendar API to retrieve accurate holiday information.

10.question: Can I change the timezone?
10.answer: You can change the current timezone from 'Time Zone' in the settings screen. This is useful when you're abroad or working in a different timezone.

11.question: What should I do if the app isn't working properly?
11.answer: First, try completely closing and restarting the app. If the problem persists, please contact our support team.

12.question: What should I do if data isn't syncing?
12.answer: Check your internet connection and restart the app. If the problem continues, try logging out and then logging back in.

13.question: How do I delete my account?
13.answer: For account deletion, please contact our support team. Identity verification is required to safely process the deletion.

14.question: Can I backup my data?
14.answer: We automatically backup your data using cloud services. As long as you're logged into your account, your data is safely stored.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.description: Step-by-step guide from basic features to advanced functions of 7days.
guide.footer: If you have any other questions, please feel free to contact support.

1.title: Creating Events
1.description: Tap a date on the calendar to create a new event. Enter the title, time, location, and notes, then save.
1.tips: Long press to create events spanning multiple days.

2.title: Editing and Deleting Events
2.description: Tap an existing event to open the details screen. Use the edit button to modify the content or the delete button to remove the event.

3.title: Switching Between Month, Week, and Day Views
3.description: Use the buttons at the top of the screen to change the display format. Choose the view that best suits your needs.

1.title: Creating New Calendars
1.description: Tap 'Create Calendar' from the sidebar. You can manage separate calendars for family, work, personal use, and more.
1.tips: Color-code calendars to visually distinguish them.

2.title: Switching Calendars
2.description: Tap a calendar name in the sidebar to switch the displayed calendar. You can also display multiple calendars simultaneously.

3.title: Changing Calendar Settings
3.description: Tap the '⋮' icon next to the calendar name to rename, change color, delete, and configure other settings.

1.title: How to Invite Members
1.description: Select 'Invite Members' from calendar settings. You can invite other users via QR code or invitation link.

2.title: Inviting via QR Code
2.description: Tap 'Invite with QR Code' to display a QR code. Have the person you want to invite scan this code.
2.tips: QR codes have an expiration date. Complete the invitation within the valid period.

3.title: Copying Invitation Link
3.description: Use 'Copy Invitation Link' to copy the invitation URL to clipboard. Share it via email or messaging apps.

1.title: Setting Up Push Notifications
1.description: Turn on 'Push Notifications' in the settings screen to receive notifications at event start times.
1.tips: You also need to allow notifications for the app in your device settings.

2.title: Today's Schedule Notification
2.description: From 'Today's Schedule' in settings, you can receive daily notifications of your schedule at a specified time.

3.title: Customizing Notification Timing
3.description: When creating events, you can individually set notification timing (5 minutes before, 15 minutes before, 1 hour before, etc.).

1.title: Switching to Dark Mode
1.description: Turn on 'Dark Mode' in settings to change the entire app to a dark theme. Easy on the eyes and saves battery.

2.title: Displaying Rokuyou
2.description: Turn on 'Rokuyou' in settings to display traditional Japanese calendar markers like taian and butsumetsu.

3.title: Setting Week Start Day
3.description: Choose whether the week starts on Sunday or Monday in settings. Configure it to your preference.

1.title: Holiday Display Settings
1.description: From 'Holidays' in settings, you can display accurate holiday information using Google Calendar API.

2.title: Changing Timezone
2.description: Change the current timezone from 'Time Zone' in settings. Useful when living abroad or on business trips.

3.title: Profile Settings
3.description: Tap the profile section in the sidebar to set your name and profile picture.

1.title: Gesture Controls
1.description: Swipe left or right to navigate months, swipe up or down to change display format.

2.title: Using the Search Function
2.description: When you have many events, use the search function to quickly find specific events.

3.title: Backup and Data Sync
3.description: If you're logged in with an account, your data is automatically saved to the cloud and synced across devices.
3.tips: Using the same account on multiple devices will automatically sync your data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy ("Policy") defines how this application ("App") handles personal information. We are committed to protecting your personal information to ensure you can use our services with confidence.

1.title: 1. Information We Collect
1.content:
The App may collect the following information:

・Information provided during account creation (email address, username, etc.)
・Calendar data (events, tasks, notes, etc.)
・Information about app usage
・Device information (OS, device identifiers, etc.)
・Location information (only when permitted by user)

2.title: 2. Purpose of Use
2.content:
Collected personal information is used for the following purposes:

・Providing and improving app services and features
・Providing user support
・Maintaining security and preventing unauthorized use
・Developing new features and services
・Creating statistical data (anonymized)
・Fulfilling legal obligations

3.title: 3. Information Sharing
3.content:
We do not provide personal information to third parties except in the following cases:

・When explicit user consent is obtained
・When disclosure is required by law
・When necessary to protect life, body, property of users or third parties
・When provided to contractors necessary for service provision (under appropriate contracts)
・In case of business succession through merger, acquisition, etc.

4.title: 4. Data Storage
4.content:
・Personal information is stored for the period necessary to achieve the purpose of use
・Data is deleted within 30 days after account deletion
・Information required to be stored by legal obligation is kept for the legal retention period
・Data is stored under appropriate security measures

5.title: 5. Security
5.content:
We implement the following security measures to protect personal information:

・Data encryption (at rest and in transit)
・Access control and authentication systems
・Regular security audits
・Employee education on personal information protection
・Unauthorized access monitoring systems

6.title: 6. User Rights
6.content:
Users have the following rights regarding their personal information:

・Request for disclosure of personal information
・Request for correction/deletion of personal information
・Request to stop use of personal information
・Right to data portability
・Withdrawal of consent

To exercise these rights, please contact us through the app's inquiry function or support.

7.title: 7. Use of Cookies and Similar Technologies
7.content:
The App may use the following technologies:

・Authentication tokens (maintaining login status)
・Local storage (storing settings)
・Analytics tools (analyzing anonymized usage patterns)

Information collected through these technologies is used for service improvement.

8.title: 8. Third-Party Services
8.content:
The App uses the following third-party services:

・Authentication service (Supabase Auth)
・Database service (Supabase Database)
・Cloud storage services
・Analytics services

Each service has its own privacy policy. Please refer to each service's privacy policy for details.

9.title: 9. Location Information
9.content:
Regarding location information:

・Location information is collected only when explicitly permitted by the user
・Location information is used for location-based reminder features, etc.
・Permission to use location information can be changed at any time in device settings
・Precise location information is not collected; use is limited to the minimum necessary scope

10.title: 10. Minor's Personal Information
10.content:
・Personal information of children under 13 is not collected without parental consent
・If it is discovered that a child under 13 has provided personal information, it will be promptly deleted
・Parents may request confirmation or deletion of their child's personal information

11.title: 11. International Data Transfers
11.content:
・Personal information may be stored on servers outside Japan with appropriate protective measures
・Appropriate protective measures based on laws of the destination country or region are ensured
・We comply with applicable international privacy regulations such as EU GDPR

12.title: 12. Changes to Privacy Policy
12.content:
・This Policy may be changed due to legal changes or service improvements
・Important changes will be notified through in-app notifications or email
・Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the changes
・The latest version is always available within the app

13.title: 13. Contact
13.content:
For inquiries, complaints, or requests regarding personal information handling, please contact us through:

・In-app inquiry function
・Support contact from settings screen

We will respond to your inquiries without delay.
